slides.title: What my 2007 G500 has needed so far.
slides.body: Two jobs. Both are on the list of what goes on a W463 G 500. Swipe.

slides.title: My biggest issue so far.
slides.body: Oil collects in the V at the front of the engine and runs down the block. Cheap parts and a simple fix; most of the bill is labor.
slides.tag: Check the front of the engine

slides.title: Still working through them.
slides.body: On most G's the fault is in the vacuum system, not the axles. Mine most likely needs bleeding or new lines.

slides.title: Buy a 2005–08.
slides.body: The 2002–04 US trucks have the electrical gremlins. On any year: look for oil at the front of the engine and test every locker on a loose surface.

end.title: Save this for your G 500 hunt.
end.body: Years to avoid, what breaks and a free inspection checklist.
